newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs firms up Japanese distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs firms up Japanese distribution deal.

text.p: Anglo-Australian drugs company Cortecs International Ltd announced on Monday that its Japanese partner Zenyaku Kogyo had secured permission to distribute its Helisal rapid blood test product.

Cortecs said Zenyaku had obtained regulatory approval from Japanese regulators for distribution and had also signed an exclusive marketing and distribution agreement with local firm Zeria Pharmaceuticals for the product.
Helisal rapid blood, to be marketed in Japan as Helitest, is the first whole blood Helicobacter Pylori rapid point of care test to receive marketing approval in Japan.
Helitest is a rapid doctor's office test for the detection of antibodies against the H. Pylori bacterium, considered to be the cause of peptic ulcers and gastritis.
Cortecs also announced it was about to complete the diagnostic development of Osteosal One Step, a possible diagnostic for brittle bone disease later in life.
"Subject to favourable results on these tests, the company expects to launch the product prior to the end of this year," Cortecs said.
